notes.title: Rollback To Previous Version
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Players[/h3]
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused by the performance issues reported in the latest version of the game. To ensure a better gaming experience, we have decided to roll back to the previous stable version. This decision was made to prevent further impact on your gameplay.

For those who enjoy the new features introduced in the latest version, we have moved it to a preview branch named [b][feature_newui][/b]. You can switch to this branch to continue using the new version if you prefer.

Our team is actively working on resolving the issues, and once the fixes are implemented, we will re-release the updated version. We appreciate your patience and support, and we are committed to avoiding similar situations in the future.

[h3]How to Switch to the New UI Branch:[/h3]
1. Right-click on the game in your Steam [b]LIBRARY[/b].  
2. Select [b]"properties..."[/b].  
3. Go to the[b] "Betas" [/b]tab.  
4. Choose the [b][feature_newui][/b] branch from the dropdown menu.  
5. Close the page, and the game will update automatically.  

[h3]To Switch Back to the Default Branch:[/h3]
Follow the same steps, but select [b]"None"[/b] from the dropdown menu.

tags.feature: For those who enjoy the new features introduced in the latest version, we have moved it to a preview branch named [b][feature_newui][/b].

[img]https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1991/2331/files/Image.png?v=1717474606[/img]

[img]https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1991/2331/files/3_in_one__1200x675___R2.jpg?v=1717474602[/img]

notes.title: Patch Note 0.3.6.4040
notes.content:
[h3]New & Changes[/h3]
[b]Added "Star Power" Effects[/b]
[list]
[*] Increasingly flashy floor and scene effects that escalate with multiplier levels
[/list]
[b]Introduced a Play Space Scaling Modifier to reduce the space requirement[/b]
[list]
[*] Player can choose from three levels of play space width:
[*] Normal, which is 2.4 meters wide
[*] Middle, which is 1.8 meters wide
[*] Small, which is 1.5 meters wide.
[/list]
[b]Merged Offline & Online Custom Song List[/b]
[list]
[*] Custom songs that lack album information will be displayed alongside subscribed songs from mod.io
[*] Custom songs that are bundled using albums will continue to be displayed separately
[/list]
[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[b]Fixed an issue which lasers are not correctly shown in LIV camera
Fixed some issues with mod.io UI[/b]

notes.title: Patch Note 0.3.5.3909
notes.content:
[h2]New & Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] When Resetting / Binding shoes, shoes will face forward instead of looking direction
[*] Added Adjust Shoes Feature
[olist]
[*] Recommended usage:
[*] Using [Refresh/Reset Shoes] to get correct tracker & L/R assignment 
[*] Then use [Adjust Shoes] to get ideal binding
[*] We're working on making this into a more unified flow later
[/olist]
[*] Added Beat Line Offset on pause menu. Allow moving Beat Line (Judgement Line) forward/backward
[/list]

tags.feature: Added Adjust Shoes Feature
Added Beat Line Offset on pause menu. Allow moving Beat Line (Judgement Line) forward/backward

notes.title: Patch Note 0.3.4.3509
notes.content:
[h2]New[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Ignore L/R modifier
[*] Long note can be triggered without hitting the  head part
[*] Added new scene lighting effects
 Nicer shadows, Vivid lights, WOW 
[*] Added Safe Zone Warning options
 Allow turning off warning effects completely
 Use at your own risk of breaking your toes or PC :P
[/list]

[h2]Mod.io integration (Beta)[/h2]
[list]
[*] Support downloading custom maps in-game.
[*] Support uploading beatmaps on Mod.io page: 
 https://mod.io/g/dancedash
[*] More details at discord channel:
 https://discord.com/channels/1124276083299197018/1133435074403111022
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that controller haptic has inverted L/R sometimes 
[*] Changed preview length to 20 seconds
[*] Fixed a height calculation issue
[*] Fixed some spelling in credits screen
[/list]
